answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 30720 Country: India Title: Is It Permissible Offering Namaz Wearing Shoes Can We Do This? Question: Assalamalaikum Is It Permissible Offering Namaz Wearing Shoes Can We Do This Pls Reply Answer ID: 30720 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 602/395/H=1432) If the shoes are entirely clean and you offer salah at your home alone, it is allowable provided the shoes do not have shape that causes problem or inconvenience. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
